## What changed?

Describe the added MAGI-2 case, PE template improvement, or documentation update.

## Source and verification

- Link the original source (or note that this is an original reproduction).
- Confirm whether `MAGI-2` (flagship) or `MAGI-2-preview` was used.

## Before submitting

- [ ] Updated `content/prompts.json` (do not edit generated `README*.md` files directly).
- [ ] Kept large `.mp4` files out of Git (video links go in `video_url`; local previews under `assets/examples/<id>/` stay `<= 500 KB`).
- [ ] Recorded creator credit, model variant, parameters, and rights status.
- [ ] Ran `python3 scripts/build_readme.py`.
- [ ] Ran `python3 scripts/validate.py` and `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
